$comment: Named execution profiles. Each stage value is a provider spec: mock, cli:<name>, openrouter (use the stage default from config/models.json), openrouter:<slug>, or api:jev (judge/compare only). faceoff and auditJudges feed the optional post-escalate stages.

mock.description: Deterministic offline providers. No network, no CLIs, no keys.

openrouter.description: One OPENROUTER_API_KEY over HTTP. Stage models come from config/models.json (openrouter.stages).

fleet.description: Local terminal CLIs: Claude Code translates, Grok back-translates blind, Codex judges.
